title: In the face of the climate crisis, vulnerable communities are hit the hardest
discussion_signal: The post frames social protection as both a resilience tool for climate-exposed communities and part of a fair transition, with public discussion emphasizing that those most affected are often least covered.
linked_research_question: How can social-protection systems reduce unequal climate exposure while supporting a fair transition to sustainable livelihoods?
limits: The post is institutional communication and does not provide country-level coverage estimates
It states a policy rationale rather than measuring impact
The discussion does not represent all climate-vulnerable groups or policy disagreements
